BiblicalUsage: Hemyah is a sound, a noise, and it appears once, in the fall of the king of Babylon. In Isaiah 14:11 the pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of the viols with it, and the worms are spread under him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is the end of every proud song: the music goes down to the grave with the singer, and the worms keep the beat.
